description: Return a bounded scalar count of nondeleted ACT-R memories, including archived memories and knowledge-base chunks. The count is not a content fingerprint and database COUNT work is not constant-time.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Scalar corpus count, scope, UTC observation interval and completeness
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A missing count with complete=false is unavailable data, never zero.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use count only when complete is true.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Counting the stored ACT-R memory corpus
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: The bounded scalar count was unavailable or malformed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Treat the count as unavailable; do not interpret it as zero.
